The structure of Lu10Ge10 (reduced formula LuGe) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 20 atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ge centers with 9 neighbors (4 Ge, 5 Lu) and Lu centers with 10 neighbors (6 Ge, 4 Lu), with Ge–Ge and Ge–Lu distances near 2.77–3.10 Å. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and fully connected across all 20 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts include corner- and edge-sharing between 9-vertex Ge polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between 10-vertex Lu polyhedra.
